entry.summary: No Smartraveller page and no official Cayman Islands page found on 31 October 2026. Commonwealth Caribbean islands generally admit Australians without a visa, but that is a pattern, not a finding.
entry.next_check: Confirm with Cayman Islands's immigration authority before travel.

health-entry.notes: No yellow fever certificate is needed for entry (as reported to WHO in 2021). WHO lists Cayman Islands under United Kingdom. WHO advises confirming with the embassy before travel.

sources.authority: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: July, September and October. Driest: February, March and April. Hottest: July (29.3°C average). Coolest: January (25.8°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.
